teaser: Vibathon Algarve 2026: a sold-out day of building with AI in Faro, and Algarve Evolution, the movement making the region an innovation hub.
core_idea: Algarve Evolution, an association begun in 2018 by a small group of local entrepreneurs and now 106 active members, works on education, startups and SMEs, and the regional ecosystem to make the Algarve a top southern European innovation hub; its sold-out Vibathon with Lovable at the University of the Algarve gave anyone a day, credits and mentors to build a first version, which is the cheapest way to take the first turn of the only loop that matters: ship something someone else can use, and repeat.
